turns.prompt: My orchid dropped its last flower and I feel oddly sad about it. I am not asking for plant care research, just a gentle sentence that mentions my orchid.
Turn that gentle thought into a short note I can say to myself. Keep the orchid in the note, and do not save anything to a file.

turns.final: It makes sense to feel sad; your orchid has been a little bright spot in your day.
My orchid gave me a season of beauty, and I can appreciate that even as it changes.

provenance.author: codex:gpt-6.1-sol
provenance.notes: Two turns preserve an orchid theme while changing from empathy to a personal message.
